data.title: Binghatti Hillviews
data.about:
Discover Binghatti Hillviews, a visionary residential development at Dubai Science Park, seamlessly blending luxury and comfort. This architectural marvel offers meticulously designed studio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, creating a harmonious fusion of elegance and modernity. Each unit features thoughtfully crafted interiors that exude sophistication, providing residents with a refined living experience.

Located just 3 minutes from Dubai Hills Mall and within close proximity to the Mall of the Emirates, Binghatti Hillviews by Binghatti Properties offers unparalleled convenience. Residents enjoy easy access to Dubai’s dynamic hubs while retreating to a tranquil, serene community. Designed with functionality in mind, the development also includes ground-floor retail spaces, adding to the convenience and lifestyle appeal for residents.

characteristics_module.title: Binghatti Hillviews – A New Perspective on Modern Living
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location: Strategically located in Dubai Science Park, offering easy access to key city destinations.
  • Architectural Excellence: A 37-floor residential tower with sleek modern design and meticulously crafted interiors.
  • Diverse Residential Options: Offers 764 units, including studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, catering to a wide range of residents and investors.
  • Retail Convenience: Features 8 retail outlets on the ground floor.
  • High-Quality Finishes and Functional Design: Interiors designed for luxury and comfort, with thoughtful layouts and high-end finishes, creating a refined living environment.

image.name: Binghatti Hillviews at Dubai Science Park Location

location_tile.title: Unmatched Connectivity to Dubai’s Vibrant Landmarks
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Binghatti Hillviews boasts a strategic location in Dubai Science Park, placing residents just 3 minutes away from Dubai Hills Mall and a short 10-minute drive to Mall of the Emirates. With effortless access to major highways, including Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Road, residents can quickly reach Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, and Dubai Marina, making it the perfect home for professionals and families alike.

  • Dubai Hills Mall – 3 minutes
  • Mall of the Emirates – 10 minutes
  • Dubai Hills Estate – 5 minutes
  • Al Barsha South – 7 minutes
  • Downtown Dubai / Burj Khalifa – 15 minutes
  • Dubai International Airport (DXB) – 20 minutes
